title: Condition
description: Compares two values (or several conditions combined with and/or) and continues along the true or false branch.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: Comparison: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt or lte. Ordering operators need numbers.

combinator.title: Combinator
combinator.description: Multi-condition form: and (all must hold) or or (any may hold). Use with conditions instead of left/operator/right.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Multi-condition form: 1 to 10 objects {left, operator, right}, combined with the combinator. Exclusive with left/operator/right.
